text: A Postnikov tower of a space X is a sequence of fibrations Xₙ → Xₙ₋₁ where Xₙ is obtained by:
choices: killing homotopy groups above n (truncating to n-type)
explanation: Postnikov tower: Xₙ = τ_{≤n}X is the n-th truncation. πₖ(Xₙ) = πₖ(X) for k≤n and 0 for k>n. X = holim Xₙ (the homotopy limit of its Postnikov sections).
